race.description: Medx Finance & Woongarrah Wildcats Fc Provincial Mdn Plate
race.comment: CAPTAIN PEACOCK (1) raced near the speed and showed plenty of fight but just missed the placings in a busy finish last start over 1300m at Illawarra Grange. Cherry ripe after two runs back and the inside gate will afford him every chance of a breakthrough win. COLD MIST (2) racked up his eighth minor placing from 17 starts when beaten just over a length into third in a 1400m Gundagai maiden last time out. Honest but finding it hard to win - each-way the best option. ACKNOWLEDGE ME (6) was there to strike on the bend but couldn't keep going at her latest appearance over 1300m at Illawarra Grange. Suspect the addition of blinkers today might make a big difference. TITIAN HIGHLIGHT (10) didn't have a lot of luck in the early stages but rallied late to finish fifth recently over 1400m at Kembla. Lightly raced and open to further improvement. RIVER INFERNO (8) failed on debut at Gosford but is worth another chance over a bit more ground today.
